summary.text: Bill Coleman is a Republican state senator from Oklahoma Senate District 10 who took office in November 2018 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Coleman assumed office on November 21, 2018, and advanced from the Republican primary on June 16, 2026.

For 2023-2024, Ballotpedia lists him as chair of the Business and Commerce Committee, vice chair of the Senate Public Safety Committee, and a member of the Administrative Rules, Retirement and Insurance, and Senate Rules committees.
